releaseNotes: Four founder-facing pages are now rendered from the documents they were always supposed to mirror, and the drift this fixes was not cosmetic. security-review.html was missing about ten of the fifteen sections its own opening line claimed to cover, including authentication and authorization, backend and API controls, revenue abuse, and accepted risks. store-console.html had lost the console click-path table, the Apple pre-submission compliance row covering PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, ATT and account deletion, and the entire seven-item App Review Information checklist, which is Guideline 2.1 rejection-risk content. onboarding.html labelled a card Personalization and filled it with Attribution content, and had dropped the push permission prime step altogether. orchestration.html was missing seven sections and carried a state-integration table row that was never real data.

check:generated-pages is the new gate, and it asserts three things because any one alone passes vacuously: every page at the root of business/ is declared in scripts/lib/artifact-pages.ts, every declared page exists, and every page written from Markdown byte-matches a fresh render. A declare-and-verify shape was considered and rejected. Hashing a file proves someone touched it, not that the HTML is right, and it would have grandfathered all four content bugs behind a green gate.

scripts/lib/markdown-lite.ts is a hand-rolled parser for the subset these documents actually use: headings to H3, one status line, tables, flat lists, one ordered list, bold, inline code, one fenced block. It throws on anything else rather than degrading to a paragraph, because a parser that silently renders an unsupported construct as something else is the exact failure this gate exists to catch. No markdown dependency was added: two package.json files held in parity, plus dependabot splitting dependency-group updates by root, makes each half of a split update land red.

design.html and analytics-plan.html are declared starter placeholders and are deliberately not generated. Their real content only exists after a launch produces it, so rendering them from a plan document would present a plan as a finished result. Filename symmetry makes generating all eight look right; it is not.

SECURITY.md, STORE_CONSOLE.md and ONBOARDING.md gave up six pieces of internal vocabulary that check:founder-copy bans on the pages they now render into. The hand-authored HTML had already been translating them silently, which is part of how the drift went unnoticed: the page said Release Checks while the document said Release Proof. The document now says what the founder reads, and check:security's required phrase moved with it.

One accepted downgrade: orchestration.html loses its three-chip status dashboard. Synthesizing those labels needs per-page logic bolted onto a generic renderer. The trade is slightly less glanceable in exchange for seven restored sections and the removal of fabricated content.
